subject: Final-mile security sync: SOC 2 / DPA + pen-test orchestration

From: Amy Dawson <amy.dawson@shorelinepay.com>

Cc: procurement@shorelinepay.com
Date: Thu, 22 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Security sync: SOC 2 / DPA review + pen-test — availability

Hi Sean / Marissa,

We are getting our security intake lined up for Redwood as part of the integration with Shoreline Pay. We want a single coordinated run-through covering:
- SOC 2 scoping / log retention and evidence transfer expectations
- DPA terms that affect data residency and deletion windows
- Overview of your pen-test policy and scheduling (we prefer a vendor-led test)

Can we pencil a ~90-minute block next week? Our team is in ET and can do:
- Tue 27 Oct between 10:00–13:00 ET
- Wed 28 Oct between 14:00–17:00 ET

If needed we can split into a 30-minute SOC2 + 60-minute pen-test planning session. I attached a short Shoreline intake (shoreline_scope_overview.docx).

Thanks — happy to coordinate times and attendees.

Amy Dawson
Security Programs Manager, Shoreline Pay
amy.dawson@shorelinepay.com
Attachment: shoreline_scope_overview.docx (docx)

Subject: Re: Security sync: SOC 2 / DPA review + pen-test — availability

Amy — thanks for the note and the scope doc, appreciate the clarity.

We can do a split session as you suggested. Proposed plan:
- Tue 27 Oct 10:30–11:00 ET — SOC 2 scoping (30m)
- Tue 27 Oct 11:15–12:30 ET — Pen-test planning / rules of engagement (75m)

If that works for you, we'll send a calendar invite with the agenda. Attendees we plan to include from our side: myself (security lead), Marissa (customer success / onboarding), Karthik (sales / procurement contact), Irene (product infra for evidence transfer).

I attached our current evidence manifest to help the SOC2 discussion (redwood_evidence_manifest_v1.pdf). A couple of ask items up front:
- Can you confirm whether Shoreline requires encrypted evidence transfer (SFTP/Drive) or prefers a shared drive link?
- Please share the vendor contact if you plan to involve an external pen-test provider so we can align scheduling and NDAs.

I'll draft a calendar invite once you confirm.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Security & Trust | Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood_evidence_manifest_v1.pdf (pdf)

Shoreline preference for evidence transfer is SFTP for anything marked 'controlled' and a secure Drive link for general artifacts. For pen testing we will use our vendor SecOps UK (ops@secops-uk.com). I copied procurement for any contract/PO questions.

We can confirm the 10:30 / 11:15 ET slots on Tue 27 Oct. Please include bridge details; our external vendor will join the pen-test planning section only.
